prompts.Bleed: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production-ready fantasy action-game status-effect HUD icon for Bloodshift. A single isolated icon, square composition, centered, flat front view, genuinely transparent background outside the badge. Bold hand-inked cel-shaded Japanese dark-fantasy game art, sophisticated but extremely legible at 28 pixels. Shape: compact dark blue-black lacquer medallion, softly clipped octagonal corners, very thin antique gold/ivory edge with two restrained angular engraved accents, heavy dark silhouette. The emblem nearly fills the badge. Strong simple silhouette, limited colors, crisp broad highlights and shadows, no noisy grunge, no tiny filigree, no scene, no text, no letters, no numbers, no shadow outside badge. Keep overall badge identical in design language to a paired bleed/poison status set. Badge fills about 90% of the canvas with transparent margin. Main emblem: one large crimson blood droplet with a sharp upward tip and rounded bottom, rich deep red shadow on the right, vivid scarlet face, one clean warm ivory crescent reflection on the upper left. A tiny secondary red drop beside the main drop gives a bleeding impression. Entire red emblem strongly contrasted against the lacquer backing. The symbol must read instantly as BLEED.
